notes.title: Update Notes for 25th Nov
notes.content:
📜Update Notes - 25th Nov

Patch Highlights:

-Bug Fix: Every single UI in the game would go away if the screen resolution was not 1920x1080
-Added Graphics Settings

Language localizations could not be added due to technical difficulties. I will be working on a few new projects in the meantime so I don't know when new game modes or updates will come for Cooktopia.

Thank you for playing, it means a lot!

Join our discord server if you haven't already: 
https://discord.gg/gkn2YBCEEX

Updates on new projects will be posted in the discord and on all my other socials.

Cheers,
Ahmet 🍳✨

notes.title: First Update Notes for 17th Nov
notes.content:
Hello everyone, 

I'm Ahmet, the solo dev behind Cooktopia. Today is the first update of the game which brought:
-Bug fix: Free-play mode would end after 60 seconds
-Tutorial Mode

I will be working on new features and localization for other languages. Next update will hopefully consist:
-Other languages select option
-New game modes for competitive mode such as "extreme", "hardcore", "normal" and "easy"
-Character selection screen

New features I want to bring in the future when I have enough time:
-NPCS 
-Leaderboard/Scoreboard system with friends
-Customize Kitchen
-New levels and food options (pizza etc)


Thanks for playing, hope you enjoy!
Ahmet
